zh:
北京大学（Peking University）成立于1898年，初名京师大学堂，是中国第一所国立综合性大学，也是中国近代高等教育的开端。学校下设30余个学院和系部，覆盖人文社科、自然科学、工程技术、医学等全学科领域，在校生超35000人。
北京大学以“思想自由，兼容并包”为核心教育理念，在中国的现代化进程中发挥了不可替代的作用，培养了多位诺贝尔奖得主、菲尔兹奖得主，以及大批国家栋梁与学术大师。学校在基础科学、人文社科、信息技术、医学等领域稳居国内顶尖、世界前列。2026QS世界大学排名中，北京大学位列世界第14位。
en: Peking University is a public research university in Beijing, China. Founded in 1898 as Imperial University of Peking, it is China's first national comprehensive university and the birthplace of modern higher education in China. The University comprises more than 30 colleges and departments, covering humanities and social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, and medicine, with over 35,000 enrolled students. Guided by the core educational philosophy of 'freedom of thought, inclusiveness', Peking University has produced multiple Nobel Prize winners, Fields Medalists, and a large number of academic masters and national leaders. Ranked No.14 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
